description: GE Vernova, a global energy company, provides products and services that generate, transfer, convert, store, and orchestrate electricity across Europe, Asia, the Americas, the Middle East, and Africa. The company’s operations are organized into power, wind, and electrification segments. Formed in 2024 through the spinoff and merger of General Electric’s energy businesses, GE Vernova helps generate about 25% of the world’s electricity. The company’s power segment covers gas, nuclear, hydro, and steam technologies; its wind segment provides advanced onshore and offshore wind solutions; and its electrification segment delivers grid, power conversion, solar, storage, and digital orchestration technologies.

rankings.itemDescription: This energy-equipment maker, which debuts on the 500 this year, is one of three companies into which General Electric recently split: GE Aerospace (No. 118) and GE HealthCare (No. 219) are the other two. GE Vernova is a clean-energy play, specializing in wind and gas turbines; it reported $35 billion in revenue in 2024.
